verdict.rationale: Ashby's marketing lists 'Scheduling' as one of its all-in-one platform components (ashby-docs-30) and mentions interview scheduling as a webhook event type (ashby-docs-6), implying the product has a scheduling module, but no evidence describes automatic multi-interviewer panel assembly, interviewer load balancing, room booking, or conflict resolution logic. Missing for 10: documentation of load-balancing algorithm, room/resource booking automation, conflict detection/resolution, and any independent or hands-on validation that full onsite loops schedule automatically.
